items.evidence: Log lines 1-139 show the master mix is built with 106/40/4/2 µL and mixed. Then 19 µL goes to each of A1-G1, 2.5 µL forward and reverse primers go to matching wells, and 1 µL template follows the A1,A1,B1,C1,A1,A1,D1 pairing.
Log lines 198-336 add 19 µL water, 5 µL rCutSmart and 1 µL DpnI to A1-G1, then mix 3x at 30 µL. The 37/65°C incubation and the Zymo clean-up are recorded with protocol.comment in order.
Log lines 338-488 add 7 µL water and 2 µL buffer to each assembly well. They then add 3 µL frag2, 2 µL frag5, 3 µL frag6, 2 µL frags 1/3/4/7 and 1 µL enzyme, mixed 5x.

The Golden Gate program (30 cycles of 37/16°C, 60°C, 4°C) and the assembly clean-up are recorded as comments. 5 µL is then moved to cells A1-D1 (log 490-503), ice and heat shock are commented, and 250 µL LB is added (log 506-519).
Every transfer in the xfer helper picks up a new tip and drops it, and every mix uses a fresh tip per well. The log shows pick up and drop tip pairs throughout, with no tip reuse across wells.

judge.summary: The simulated run matches every pipetting step in the task. PCR setup, DpnI addition, assembly volumes and pairings, transfer to cells and LB addition are all correct. The manual steps are recorded with protocol.comment, and a fresh tip is used for every transfer and mix, so all items pass.
